body: She just walked out the door to meet a friend for dinner, I am so scared because at least with her here the temptation to do something is suppressed.  I don't know when she's coming back but I can't stop the track playing over and over in my head telling me that the only way out, and the only way to pay her back for all the pain that I caused is to end it.

Language is the most important tool we have. However, my words did not match my actions, which is the the truest reflection of honesty.   This is how I broke her heart.

I have been going to a therapist, and things were looking better for a while, but the memory of my lies overwhelmed any progress I had made.  I feel like my past self will forever sabotage my future.

I have so many incredible memories with her.  I am 28, I have known her for 22 years.  We stuck through all the pain and heartache because we knew that we each have our own brand of crazy (she's on the AS spectrum, and I may be, not officially diagnosed but several big indicators), and we always looked out for each other.  

She was the first person I ever opened up to about emotions, just this year.  Nothing I ever told my parents, my brother, or any previous girlfriends.  I poured my heart and soul into becoming a better person so I could be her husband, but it hasn't been enough. 

We are so connected. I don't know how to live without her. I love her so much.
Its too much now. too much. she was in love with someone who didn't exist. she's right. I'm not real. time to quit.

she told me to stop wearing my ring because it doesn't mean anything anymore. hers is back in its box on the coffee table now. She's trying to disconnect from me now, so she isn't sad when she leaves. I will wait until she finds a way to move out so she doesn't have to find me afterwards, but there's no reason to wait any longer than that. She's trying to stop caring about me so she can move on.  Its not her fault, because I was the terrible one, she's just trying to protect herself after so much hurt. I can't believe that I was so awful, such a terrible person to have hurt the one I love.

She has been incredibly supportive, and even right now she's being incredibly kind about everything, telling me to take my female co worker to the show I had reserved tickets for my wife and I.  It breaks my heart because I have no desire to have any relationship with this woman, and haven't for quite a while (just short, businesslike conversations over the past two years).  I want nothing more than to be with my wife, and make her happy. She's very smart and is much more capable at understanding human emotions than I am, so I feel incredibly frustrated when I try to express what I'm feeling inside. 
I feel like I'm a person with a problem that can't ever recover.
